name: 11780 · Saint James, NY
findings: ZIP 11780 (Saint James) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11780 (Saint James) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
